result.validity_reason: Verified frozen evaluation authorization and runtime timing checks passed

sampling.observation_rule: At most one regular capture per interval, plus last capture and observations explicitly parent-linked by non-observation events; no interpolation
sampling.motion_rule: First actual sample at or after each interval, plus final actual sample; no interpolation
sampling.clock_rule: Raw clocks and event order are unchanged. Wall time has initialization and task epochs only when a supervisor episode_clock_started event declares the boundary; no offset or interpolation is applied. Without that event the wall-clock scope is unclassified. Simulation time remains monotonic across the boundary.

selection_entry.reason: First short nominal case: inspect each entrant's complete task loop under the same public case.

metadata_projection.scope: Bounded display fields only; exact full metadata is retained in package.metadata_ref.
